requirement_text: Candidates may participate in the Medicine selection procedure "maximaal één keer" (at most once). An exception allows a second attempt if the candidate participates in selection and then fails their VWO final exam that same year, regardless of their performance in the selection itself.

requirement_text: An applicant may apply for a maximum of two numerus fixus (fixed-quota) programmes per academic year across Dutch universities; this can be the same programme at two different institutions, but an applicant cannot apply to both the Dutch-taught and English-taught Bachelor's in Psychology at RUG simultaneously.
